page.notes: Column 2 ends "prætextu ne-" and column 3 opens with a partly legible word, read as "[?]pandum"; the hyphenated word is not certain. "Mors ubi ubi" is printed as "vbi vbi". "Ministris" (line 3 of column 1) and "Obedientiæ falsæ substantia 15" are doubtful readings, and "Mosi cur terra promissa" carries no page number as printed. Several entries and numbers near the fold or the gutter are faint; "1ç" in "Obedientiæ falsæ substantia" is read as 15. Original uses long s and ligatures throughout; these are normalised to s. The page holds no page number, catchword or signature.
